review_method: Original generated PNG bytes were forwarded directly as image content after view_image was found unavailable due the namespace sandbox. No images were edited for inspection.

checks.dial: All three bank panels contain supported plotted information. Test/stress annotations explicitly state FSA is undefined at all saved dial points. Dashed lower bounds, defined solid curves and saved m=0 capped censor ranges are distinguished in visible labels. Both rate axes show nonnegative probability ticks; no unlabeled empty panel remains.
checks.pose: Banks occupy separate columns; error quantities occupy separate rows with explicit pixel/degree units. Each source has a consistent distinct colour, marker and line style across banks. Shared legend and axis labels are readable; no obvious text clipping or missing panels.
checks.scientific_interpretation: No full-grid upper bounds were invented. Undefined point FSA remains null, zero acceptance is not converted to safe zero, and finite bootstrap endpoints from an undefined full-data FSA were not used. Saved m=0 ranges are identified as censoring bounds, not confidence intervals.
checks.preservation: All 11 original decomposition files were hash-checked unchanged during rendering. The original five PNG hashes were rechecked afterward; original JSON hash and scientific gate remain exact.

numeric_policy_validation.independent_review: verification_audit found no blocking interpretation issue in dial_value()/prepare_dial()

remaining_original_notes: Minor original cumulative-attribution headroom and regime sign-convention notes are outside these two presentation corrections; originals remain preserved.
